reviews.title: 64gb (2x32gb) DDR5 6000 MT/s on ASROCK A620M-C
reviews.comment:
If you're running two RAM sticks, your motherboard may require the use of slots 2 and 4 for dual-channeling. It requires some adjustments in the BIOS to function correctly, as the motherboard reverts to defaults at 4800 MT/s. I had to select the AMD EXPO0-6000 profile (XMP for Intel CPUs) and change the performance mode to "Agressive".
So, far...so, good. I'll update if there are any changes!
